items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] “Five Guys Named Moe.” >> [INTERVIEWEE] “Five Guys Named Moe.” You know it’s funny how my jazz sensibilities started to become better when I started learning all those songs.

ctx.x: “Five Guys Named Moe.” You know it’s funny how my jazz sensibilities started to become better when I started learning all those songs. I even play this stuff for my kids sometimes. You know, “A Tisket A Tasket.” Ah….
